questions.question: Explain simple random sampling, stratified sampling, and systematic sampling.
questions.solution_html:
• Explain simple random sampling, stratified sampling, and systematic sampling. /[CO1]
  • Simple random sampling: Every unit has equal chance (e.g., lottery method)
  • Stratified sampling: Population divided into groups (strata), samples taken from each
  • Systematic sampling: Select every kth unit (e.g., every 5th person)
  • Explanation – (4 marks)
